verdict.rationale: Carta offers official REST API documentation, an OAuth-based developer portal, playground/sandbox, Postman guide, and reference endpoints for building integrations, plus a documented Claude MCP plugin setup for LLM access — evidence of building against official APIs/SDKs. However, there's no explicit language-specific SDK (e.g., Python/JS client libraries) mentioned, and probes show no llms.txt, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and no docs-in-markdown support, limiting AI-native/agentic tooling ergonomics. missing for 10: dedicated official SDK libraries in multiple languages, machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt for agent consumption, independent developer corroboration of SDK quality.
